objective: Show Petal Catch on the client: WheelFx renders the player's own petals from the server seed, the basket, the round HUD, the end card, the pre-decided wheel animation with both odds columns, the stand's spins label and the sounds; Menu's prize list title covers both mini-games; Models lists the client props.
inputs: src/garden-client/DashFx.client.luau (the pattern to copy), src/garden-client/ClientState.luau (SFX, EGG_COLOURS, sound), src/garden-client/CLAUDE.md
acceptance_criteria: On wheelStart the client computes WheelRules.schedule(seed, startAt) and shows each drop falling from the canopy at the server's straight-line height (plus a cosmetic sway under 0.5 studs) using petal_pink, petal_gold and pinecone clones or their part fallbacks; a landed petal settles and fades, never shown as a miss; a petal pops to the basket only on wheelCatch, with +1, +3 or a brown -2 float and the W7.2 sounds (none for a pinecone)

Round HUD shows score, the timer from endAt with GetServerTimeNow, the progress bar with the 12 and 24 marks and either 'N spins left today' or 'Practice'; it is hidden outside a round, fits a 360 px phone with autoScale and stays clear of the jump button and the quick-button column; no new quick button

End card: 'Nice catch! N petals' then the wheel panel (tier spin or lucky), 'Nice try, play again' or 'Practice round'; the wheel panel shows 8 wedges in the egg colour pairs and gold for Coins, both odds columns as percentages, and a SPIN button that plays the pre-decided 3.5 s ease-out to the wedge from wheelSpin (random offset inside the wedge, no ticking while slowing, never backing up), one chime at the stop, fanfare and a burst for celestial and aurora, and the result line; no spin-again, no countdown to the next spin, no near-miss text anywhere

SpinsLabel on the stand reads from the local Profile attribute and ProfileOnline: 'N spins left today', 'All 3 spins used today · practice rounds open' or 'Saving is off on this server · practice only'; the disc idles at 0.1 turns/s outside a round; the basket is welded to the local character's hand for the round only

The client sends nothing new; every sound goes through ClientState.sound and is silent with sfx off; Menu's DASH panel prize list is titled 'Prize eggs'; Models.CLIENT_MODELS adds wheel_disc, wheel_basket, petal_pink, petal_gold, pinecone; Relay and Night behaviour is unchanged; CI, rojo build garden.project.json, check-place, validate-tasks and check-scope pass; a Studio run with the build stamp covers W11 steps 1 to 4 and 8
verification: CI, a Studio run recorded with the build stamp (rule 13), and the GARDEN-045 QA review
notes: Display only: the client never decides a catch or a wedge. wheelSpin follows wheelOver in the same server step, so SPIN waits for it (2 s fallback enables it anyway and the result shows on arrival). GDD G4.3 is binding: no slot-machine ticking, no wobble back from a rarer wedge, no failure sound, no red flash. Models.luau changes are the one CLIENT_MODELS line; if GARDEN-044 has not uploaded ids, every prop keeps its fallback and the task still completes.
